metadata.description: Data teknis kapasitas pelabuhan dari website resmi GNI dan sumber perusahaan lainnya

sources.organization: GNI (Gunbuster Nickel Industry / Petasia Morowali Utara)
sources.page_title: GNI Port Infrastructure - Integrated Logistics Solutions

infrastructure.exclusive_road: 30 meter width dedicated road from plant to port
infrastructure.office_facilities: Port office, customs clearance center, security post

operational_details.export_destinations: Primarily China (Fujian, Zhejiang, Jiangsu provinces), also Southeast Asia
operational_details.cargo_types: NPI (Nickel Pig Iron), Ferronickel, Nickel Matte

sources.validation_method: Direct scraping + manual verification via Wayback Machine
sources.notes: Website resmi perusahaan, data teknis untuk investor. Cross-validated dengan satellite imagery.

infrastructure.airport: 1,800 meter runway for cargo + personnel transport
infrastructure.integrated_industrial_park: Direct connectivity from smelter to port via internal road

sources.notes: Data dari website resmi, tapi kurang detail teknis dibanding GNI. Airport 1.800m adalah fitur unik IMIP.

sources.document_title: ANTAM Annual Report 2023 - Pomalaa Ferronickel Operations

port_capacity.belt_conveyor: 4 km length, connects mine to port

infrastructure.project_name: P3FP (Proyek Peningkatan Produksi dan Produktivitas Feronikel Pomalaa)

operational_details.loading_efficiency: Best in class among 6 nodes (1,000 ton/hour)

sources.notes: Laporan keuangan audited, data sangat detail dan kredibel. ANTAM sebagai BUMN memiliki transparansi tinggi.

port_system.stage_1: Pelabuhan Vale Nuha (Sorowako inland port, Lake Matano)
port_system.reason_multi_stage: Sorowako is inland location (Lake Matano), requires multi-modal transport

infrastructure.ihip_project: Indonesia Halmahera Industrial Park (IHIP) new port planned 2027

sources.notes: Vale punya sistem multi-stage yang unik karena lokasi Sorowako di pedalaman (Danau Matano). IHIP port 2027 akan game-changer.

port_capacity.location: Desa Porara, Kecamatan Morosi, Kabupaten Konawe

infrastructure.exclusive_road: 30 meter width road from VDNI plant to jetty
infrastructure.environmental_mitigation: Sediment trap, oil spill response, coral transplantation

operational_details.shared_facility: OSS (Obsidian Stainless Steel) uses same jetty

sources.notes: Dokumen lingkungan resmi dari KLHK. Data teknis sangat detail, termasuk koordinat GPS jetty dan mitigasi lingkungan.

sources.article_title: OSS dan VDNI Berbagi Pelabuhan di Konawe: Model Kolaborasi atau Monopoli Logistik?

shared_facility_details.confirmation: OSS menggunakan jetty VDNI di Desa Porara
shared_facility_details.cost_sharing: OSS membayar fee per ton ke VDNI untuk akses pelabuhan
shared_facility_details.efficiency: Mengurangi duplikasi infrastruktur, tapi menciptakan dependensi OSS ke VDNI
shared_facility_details.controversy: Warga nelayan mengeluh akses pantai terbatas sejak jetty dibangun

community_impact.compensation: One-time payment, belum ada program CSR berkelanjutan

sources.notes: Media investigasi kredibel, mengkonfirmasi model shared facility OSS-VDNI. Juga mengangkat isu dampak sosial.

fastest_unloading.highlight: Tertinggi berkat belt conveyor 4 km + automation

unique_infrastructure.imip_airport: 1,800m runway for cargo + personnel (only node with airport)
unique_infrastructure.vdni_oss_shared: Shared facility model (efficiency vs monopoly concern)

exclusive_roads.antam: Belt conveyor 4 km (bukan jalan, tapi lebih efisien)

gni_website.note: Website kadang down, pastikan archived copy di Wayback Machine

ukl_upl_documents.note: Butuh akun SIPPN untuk download, atau request via email ke KLHK

validation_notes.satellite_verification: Google Earth Pro + Sentinel-2 untuk konfirmasi visual jetty
validation_notes.vessel_tracking: Marine Traffic + Vessel Finder untuk validasi operational status
validation_notes.data_quality: High - mayoritas dari sumber primer (corporate reports + government docs)
